critical_vulnerability_p0.title: Stale Leadership Certificate Mutation on Uninformed Storage Node
critical_vulnerability_p0.vulnerability_analysis: In Phase 4.3, a storage node verifies that token.epoch >= highest_seen_epoch. If coordinator C1 is deposed in Term 1 and C2 is elected in Term 2, but storage node N1 has not yet observed Term 2, N1's highest_seen_epoch remains 1. C1 can continue issuing validly signed FencedOperationTokens at epoch 1 to N1, causing unauthorized committed mutations from a deposed leader.
critical_vulnerability_p0.architectural_remediation: Introduce QuorumMutationPermit requiring majority (>= 2 of 3) quorum voter signatures per mutating operation and commit index, plus durable object generation tracking on storage nodes to strictly reject stale leader mutations.
